svg.text: 03 Drawer tower case and plywood grips
TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Build the base, case sides, bottom and top; centre back panel later closes the rear.
2. Fit the top plywood L and both intermediate C channels before fitting drawers.
3. Channel ends stop between solid side panels. Do not notch the outside side faces.
4. L is 42 x 60; C is 42 x 80. All fronts remain square and edge banded.
